title: Wildlife Habitat Corridors
description: Ungulate wildlife habitat corridors in the Western United States, derived from the USGS Ungulate Migrations of the Western United States, Volume 2. The dataset covers migration routes and corridors for elk and other large ungulates across the western US, distributed in vector formats including Shapefile, GeoParquet, GeoPackage, and PMTiles.
